claim: The section table is atypical for an MSVC build (names such as .arch, .xtext, '.bss a', .srdata; flags inconsistent with names) and the static import table holds only 199 functions from 21 DLLs.
evidence: 17 sections; .srdata entropy 7.828, '.bss a' 73 MB executable+writable with entropy 7.243; ASLR (DYNAMIC_BASE) not set.
game_build_compatibility: Measured on exe SHA-256 ED0D95CABB033CD66AAA99D699374881846C3CB03EC345F1123D82D45E0BDAEF (FileVersion 1.0.8874.0, Steam buildid 3095001)
verification_method: Read-only local inspection with tools/environment/discover_game.py and pe_inventory.py; re-run scripts/inventory.ps1 to reproduce.
limitations: Strongly suggests a code-protection or packing layer, whose identity is UNKNOWN. Third-party reports about Denuvo removal must be checked separately. Static analysis of the on-disk binary is therefore expected to be of limited value, and deeper analysis of the protection is out of scope.
next_experiment: Legal review (EU Directive 2009/24/EC Art. 6) before any runtime observation; prefer documented public APIs and the game's own data files.
